Sara-5 non-technical shareable bracket; lightest morphological payload, carries a numeric error in the thesis to fix and a tangency to the shipped ibrahim-wife-laugh-strike via the dahik root.

HASAN-1: Preempt the burhan collision IN-ARTICLE: رهن (pledge, 3 verses) is a different root from برهن (burhan/proof, 8 verses); فَرِهَٰنٌ in 2:283 only visually resembles بُرْهَٰن — this is the single strongest one-tweet attack, disarm it explicitly.

Defend 'you ARE the collateral' grammatically: رهين/رهينة is فعيل بمعنى مفعول (that-which-is-held-in-pledge), anchored to Tabari/Qurtubi (marhun/marhunah bi-amalihi); assert the grammar because Khalil-readers will test whether رهين could be active.

Make redemption STRUCTURAL not an optional coda: 74:39 illa ashaba l-yamin and the 52:21 context (believers reunited, deeds undiminished) make the pledge redeemable; a one-sided doom framing misreads the very verses cited (also answers Khalid's pair-the-dread-with-redemption note).
Surface Zaynab's gem: gender concord — rahin agrees with masc. imri (52:21), rahinah with fem. nafs (74:38); the Quran matches the collateral's grammar to the debtor it names.

Keep the pawnshop analogy strictly illustrative; theology is textual (kasaba/kasabat), not metaphor-derived. Keep 3-verse scope; no 'the Quran always' overreach. Keep citation load light — a tadabbur, not a tafsir digest.
Optional one-liner: 2:283 has a variant qiraah (رِهان vs رُهُن), irrelevant to the 3-verse root count, pre-empts a rigorous reader.
YASMIN-1: FIX the botched self-correction: state FIVE roots of freq 5-100 confined to one surah (شطر/al-Baqarah, ميل/an-Nisa, صيد/al-Maidah, قمص/Yusuf, كهف/al-Kahf), NOT three; delete the 'three' note. If a smaller set is wanted, define the extra filter explicitly and re-derive honestly.
ṣayd (صيد) is SIX occurrences in al-Maidah, not five.

Reframe title/thesis away from literal single-physical-object identity: the reveal is that the same WORD (qamis, always Yusuf's shirt) recurs six times and never leaves the surah (lie -> verdict -> cure); do not claim it is one physical cloth, and do not rescue that via the 'shirt of Ibrahim' israiliyyat.
Comparative-Genesis discipline: give Joseph's coat its dignity, no deficient-predecessor staging; do not assert the sight-restoration (12:93/96) is 'unique to the Quran' without qualification.
Scope the count as root-level q-m-ṣ, six occurrences (12:18/25/26/27/28/93). Simple layman title, no superlatives, mushaf-order safe (single surah).
HASAN-2: REPLACE THE EXHIBIT: GRAPH-12 (sarsar/wind/Ad) is a different word entirely; attach a real Wadud census (root ودد = 29 tokens; divine-name lemma وَدُود = exactly 2 at 11:90 and 85:14) before drafting.

Fix the paired-name claim: name the actual frames — 85:14 = al-Ghafur (the Forgiving); 11:90 = ar-Rahim (the Merciful) right after 'seek forgiveness of your Lord and repent.' Reword to 'both within a frame of forgiveness and mercy,' not 'both paired with a forgiveness name.'
Reframe title/thesis — 11:90 is Shuayb speaking about his Lord — prefer 'The Quran names God the Most Loving exactly twice' over 'God calls Himself.'
Soften 'right after' for 85:14 to 'in the same passage / in the aftermath of.'

Keep 'burned believers' Quran-anchored (fire, fuel, al-hariq, 'what they did to the believers'); note 'alive' is the mainstream reading, not verbatim text. Do not soften the sin to make the mercy land.
Disclose lemma-scope (broader love-vocabulary is not only twice). Acknowledge al-Wadud's faul pattern — loving-and-beloved / worthy of love — not the flat 'Most Loving.'
Differentiate from the existing Shuayb marketplace/anguish pieces that already treat the 11:90 Madyan context.
